# bunway

> Self-hosted LLM gateway on Bun: OpenAI-compatible endpoint, priority failover
> across upstreams, SQLite billing, single-container dashboard.

bunway speaks the OpenAI chat completions API on /v1/chat/completions, so any
OpenAI SDK works by changing the base URL to http://localhost:3001/v1. Requests
are routed across upstream providers in priority order: a failing provider is
marked unavailable or put into cooldown and traffic spills to the next one.
Every request is priced per token (input, output, cache read, cache write) and
recorded in SQLite; the built-in /console dashboard shows KPIs, request
trends, per-provider routing state, and error events. The gateway has zero npm
runtime dependencies — it runs on Bun alone — and ships as a single Docker
image. You can try the whole thing without any real API key: the bundled demo
stack starts a mock upstream and pre-seeds data, and docs/deploy.md walks
through deployment and verification step by step, each step with the command
and the expected output. Note that the admin API and /console are meant for a
trusted network; do not expose the admin port directly to the public internet.

## Docs

- [Deploy and verify](docs/deploy.md): step-by-step with expected output
- [Gateway reference](docs/gateway.md): endpoints, base_url rule, provider config, failover, pricing
- [Chinese README](README.zh-CN.md): 中文说明
